senses.gloss:
पोष पोष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पुष्), thriving,
growth, increase; welfare, prosperity, plenty, abun-
dance; nourishing, cherishing; maintaining, sup-
porting.

पोषक, अस्, m. one who feeds or nourishes; a
nourisher, supporter, breeder, keeper.

पोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, nourishing, cherishing [cf.
पक्ष-प्˚]; bringing up, breeding; (अम्), n. the
act of nourishing, cherishing, fostering, supporting.

पोषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cherished or pro-
tected, to be nourished.

पोषयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, nourishing, cherishing,
one who breeds or rears.

पोषयित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, causing to grow, nourish-
ing, cherishing (Ved.); (उस्), m. (according to a
Scholiast) the Koïl or Kokila or Indian cuckoo;
(probably) a crow.

पोषयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. causing to thrive,
nourishing, causing prosperity or welfare, advan-
tageous.

पोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, nourished, cherished, fostered,
supported.

पोषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cherished or pro-
tected.

पोषितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, nourishing, feeding; one
who breeds or rears.
पोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, nourishing, bringing up, rearing.
पोषुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. prospering, growing.

पोष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a nourisher, cherisher, one
who brings up; (टा), m. a protector, nourisher,
cherisher; grey bonduc.
—पोष्टृ-वर, अस्, आ, अम्,
the best of nourishers, nourishing best.

पोष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, well-fed, thriving; causing
welfare or prosperity, prosperous; to be nourished
or cherished, to be taken care of, to be fed, to be
brought up; copious.
—पोष्य-त्व, अम्, n. the being
one who is to be cherished; being taken care of.
—पोष्य-पुत्र or पोष्य-पुत्रक, अस्, m. ‘a son
to be brought up,’ an adopted son.
—पोष्यपुत्र-
करण, अम्, n. adoption.
—पोष्य-वर्ग, अस्, m. a
class of persons or objects to be cherished, as parents,
children, guests, and the sacred fire; a family, house-
[]
hold.
—पोष्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. causing pros-
perity; (Sāy. = बहु-पोष्य-जन-युक्त.)

पोषध पोषध, अस्, m. (with Buddhists)
renewal of religious vows.

पोषधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps) one who renews
religious vows.
